current_logic.universe_selection: CS_RANK screening with anchor/macro loading; hard-stop if universe < 3 symbols.
current_logic.regime_classification: JAX-native Student-t HMM with 6 features (Trend, Vol, Downside Vol, CS Dispersion, OI Delta, Funding Momentum). Uses asymmetric nu-priors (nu=3.5 for BEAR) and sigmoid TVTP for state-specific stickiness.
current_logic.supervised_tail_separation: Causal IS-trained supervised tail scores split into q10/q05/q03 tiers across 4h/8h/16h horizons. logistic+isotonic calibration with rank blending.
current_logic.regime_boosting: Supervised score bundles forwarded through hazard overlay. Phase 3.7 introduced intersection logic (p_off * down24) for sharpened crisis identification.
current_logic.hazard_overlay: Separate tail/crisis hazard layer estimates pre_crisis_hazard, realized_crisis_hazard, and 4h/8h/24h tail hazards. Realized logit uses bias=-2.8 and intersection features.
current_logic.policy_mapping: Policy mapper converts regime posterior and hazard outputs into tiered soft_damp, hard_damp, near_flat, flat, and rebalance controls.
current_logic.diagnostics: Separates regime quality, execution quality, and tiered damp coverage. Avg-Duration target > 18 bars (currently 22.3 bars).
current_logic.alpha_generation: LightGBM v6 alpha is regime-conditional, with chop-fragility filtering.
current_logic.risk_management: Tiered execution protection with Student-t backend. BEAR-OFF state has increased min-duration (42 bars) to prevent premature defense exit.
current_logic.runtime_bootstrap: JAX is pinned to CPU-only initialization to avoid CUDA conflicts.
current_logic.parallel_processing: Optimized for 8-core/16GB RAM: 4 workers, 4 chunk size cap.
